hero.title: I build headphone amps, homeservers, and custom keyboards.
hero.body: Learning electronics by building — from analog and discrete headphone amplifiers to ESP32-based IoT and self-hosted home infrastructure.

about.title: Hi, I'm Ulil Albab
about.intro: A beginner with real enthusiasm for electronics — both analog and digital. I also enjoy learning about computers, networking, and lately I've become a fan of vacuum tubes.
interests: Tinkering with electronics and vacuum tubes

projects.title: Selected work
projects.intro: Three areas I keep coming back to — audio electronics, home infrastructure, and input devices.

items.title: Headphone Amplifiers
items.description: A series of headphone amplifier builds — from analog and hybrid designs to a fully discrete op-amp. Focused on audio transparency and learning through iteration.

items.title: Homeserver & IoT
items.description: A self-hosted home ecosystem: centralized IoT, local NAS storage, and on-prem services — full control, no cloud dependency.
points: Centralized home IoT on ESP32 & ESP8266
Local NAS for backup and media

items.title: Custom Mechanical Keyboards
items.description: Hand-wired custom keyboards and wireless macropads — combining electronics with firmware experiments.
points: VIA support for easy keymap configuration
Wireless macropad on ESP32 with OLED display

items.title: FuruHibi R2R DAC
items.description: An ESP32-S3 R2R DAC with its supporting software — a Windows & Android companion app, browser-based DSP, and cloud presets in one audio ecosystem.
points: Resistor-ladder DAC with Bluetooth and USB UAC inputs
PEQ, loudness, and surround DSP controlled from the browser
Windows & Android companion app with cloud preset sync
